description: Use for one site's run history, delta since the previous run, radar context and archived GSC month. Latest and previous runs with coverage, new failures/resolved/pages added or removed, highest-priority fixes with severity and sample URLs, recent P0/P1 radar updates that hit its failing rules, uptime/CWV/watchdog signals, and the archived GSC month. The delta comes from stored audit history, which no source repo can produce. Read-only, no live GSC or page fetch. Requires the audit:read scope.

radarDays.description: Only radar updates published within this many days
